Editor.Title: Paperdoll Layout (all characters)
Editor.Label: Label on the sheet
Editor.NoSelection: Click a slot to edit it, or a + to add a new one.
Editor.Hint: Wondrous items have no slot type in dnd5e. They are recognized by name (e.g. Cloak, Boots, Ring). If that fails, hold Shift while dropping it on the slot: the item remembers the slot type.

Editor.Name: Paperdoll layout
Editor.Label: Edit slots
Editor.Hint: Add, remove and type the equipment slots of the paperdoll for all characters.

Enabled.Name: Replace inventory tab
Enabled.Hint: Show the paperdoll inventory on character sheets.

HideSidebar.Name: Hide sidebar on the inventory tab
HideSidebar.Hint: The portrait moves into the paperdoll; other tabs keep the sidebar.

PlayersEquip.Name: Players may equip
PlayersEquip.Hint: If disabled, only the GM can change the paperdoll.

Strict.Name: Strict slot types
Strict.Hint: Only allow items that match the slot type.

HideWorn.Name: Hide equipped items from the list
HideWorn.Hint: Equipped items, weapon sets and attached containers only appear on the paperdoll, not in the item list.

Ground.Name: Allow dropping on the ground
Ground.Hint: Needs Ascandir - DnD5e Lootplacement or Item Piles.

AutoEquip.Name: Auto-place equipped items
AutoEquip.Hint: Equipping an item in the list (shield icon) moves it onto the matching paperdoll slot or into the active weapon set.
